citation: Ladwa M, et al. Ethnic differences in beta cell function occur independently of insulin sensitivity and pancreatic fat in black and white men. BMJ Open Diabetes Res Care 2021.
protocol: Mixed meal tolerance test after an overnight fast, samples 0 to 180 min (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 75, 90, 120, 150, 180) for glucose, C-peptide, insulin, glucagon, NEFA
population: n=23 white European and n=23 black West African men, normal glucose tolerance, BMI about 26.6
note: C-peptide and insulin with secretion modelling, two ethnic groups; meal composition needs checking in the methods and the table is mostly areas.
